title: Negative forms and adjectives in the past
summary: ない is an い-adjective meaning "is not", and it builds every negative. い-adjectives make their past with かった.

blocks.text: Everything negative in Japanese is built on one word: **ない**. It is an **い-adjective** meaning "does not exist" or "is not". The picture: **doing** something is a verb, but **not doing** it is a **state**, so it takes an adjective as its engine.
**ある** means "exists" (for things). **ない** is its opposite: "does not exist". Because ない is an い-adjective, it can pull a train by itself.
The copula works the same way. だ becomes **ではない**: で is the て-form of だ, は adds emphasis ("as for being a pen…"), and ない says it does not hold. In speech it is often じゃない.
これはペンではない。 This is not a pen.
The past of だ is **だった**: 学生だった (was a student). The negative past is **ではなかった**.

blocks.jp: さくらは学生ではなかった。

blocks.text: Attach ない to the **あ-stem** of the verb: change the last kana from the **う-row** to the **あ-row**. The one exception is verbs ending in う, which use **わ**. Ichidan verbs just drop る.
さくらが走らなかった。 Sakura did not run.
Change the final **い** to **く**, then add ない: 赤い → **赤くない**. For the **past**, change い to **かった**: 怖い → **怖かった** (it was scary). The negative past of anything is **なかった**.

blocks.jp: あの犬は怖くなかった。

blocks.text: Now every verb has four forms. Start from the plain verb, make it negative with ない, then put each one in the past: the past is the た-form from lesson 5, and the negative past turns ない into **なかった**, as any い-adjective does.

ている (lesson 4) says an action is going on. Its engine is いる, an ordinary ichidan verb, so it takes the same four forms. In the past, **ていた** means the action was going on at some moment back then: "was running", not "is running".

blocks.jp: さくらが走っていなかった。

blocks.text: **ます**, the polite verb ending (食べます is a polite 食べる; more in lesson 17), has its own negative, **ません** (not ますない).
And **いい** (good) uses its old stem **よい** for every change: **よかった** (it was good), **よくない** (not good). Never いくない or いかった.

blocks.jp: 昨日の映画はよかった。

blocks.title: Remember
items: **ない** is an い-adjective: it changes like one (**なかった**).
Verb: **あ-stem + ない** (う-verbs use **わ**); ichidan: drop る.
い-adjective: **い → くない**; past **い → かった**.
Noun / copula: **ではない**, past **だった**, negative past **ではなかった**; polite verb: **ません**.
**いい → よくない / よかった**.
